models_evaluated: Deep learning AI model for gestational age estimation from blind ultrasound sweeps, integrated into a low-cost battery-powered device

links.outcome: Consistency of gestational age estimation accuracy across study sites (Zambia vs North Carolina)
links.effect: Performance was consistent in prespecified subgroups including the Zambia and North Carolina cohorts; overall MAE 3.2 vs 3.0 days for the standard (difference 0.2 days, 95% CI -0.1 to 0.5).
links.quote: Performance was consistent in prespecified subgroups, including the Zambia and North Carolina cohorts and those with high body mass index.

links.outcome: Performance across prespecified patient subgroups, including high body mass index
links.effect: Performance was consistent in prespecified subgroups, including those with high BMI; the primary-window MAE was 3.2 (0.1) days vs 3.0 (0.1) days for the standard.
links.quote: Performance was consistent in prespecified subgroups, including the Zambia and North Carolina cohorts and those with high body mass index.

unlisted_practices: Enabling novice users with no prior sonography training to operate AI-guided point-of-care ultrasound in low-resource settings

screen.reason: Prospective diagnostic accuracy study testing an AI-enabled ultrasound tool used prospectively by novice operators on pregnant patients in Zambia and North Carolina.
